regulations.full_title: Medical electrical equipment Part 1: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance

MEDICAL ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT – Part 1-11: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance – Collateral Standard: Requirements for medical electrical equipment and medical electrical systems used in the home healthcare environment

products.manufacturer_address: No.3 JinPing Street, Ya An Road, Nankai District, Tianjin, China

intended_use_items.description: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages.
intended_use_items.use_environment: Household environment and healthcare provider settings
intended_use_items.users: Consumers in the household environment and healthcare providers

semantic_fragments.content: The tests results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. This report shall not be reproduced except in full without the written approval of the testing laboratory. List of test equipment must be kept on file and available for review. Additional test data and/or information provided in the attachments to this report. Throughout this report a comma/point is used as the decimal separator.

This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members' health conditions easily and quickly.

Possible test case verdicts: N/A - test case does not apply to the test object; Pass (P) - test object does meet the requirement; N/E - test object was not evaluated for the requirement; Fail (F) - test object does not meet the requirement. Abbreviations: N.C. = normal condition; S.F.C. = single fault condition; MOOP = means of Operator protection; MOPP = means of Patient protection.
Test laboratory: Tianxu(Tianjin)Testing Technology Service Co.,LTD, Address: 101, First floor, Building L, No.3 JinPing Street, Ya An Road, Nankai District, Tianjin, China.
